functions._arhInnovationStats: function _arhInnovationStats(s,meas,rx){if(!s._kfX||!s._kfP)return null;const model=_sarhMeasurementModel(s._kfX,rx,rx),H=_sarhMeasurementJacobian(model),Ht=_matTranspose(H,4,6),R=_arhMeasurementCov(meas),PHt=_matMul(s._kfP,6,6,Ht,4),S=_matAdd(_matMul(H,4,6,PHt,4),R),Sinv=_matInv(S,4);if(!Sinv)return null;const innov=new Float64Array([meas.rangeM-model.h[0],angNorm(meas.azRad-model.h[1]),angNorm(meas.elRad-model.h[2]),meas.dopplerPathRateMps-model.h[3]]);let nis=0;for(let i=0;i<4;i++)for(let j=0;j<4;j++)nis+=innov[i]*Sinv[_mIdx(i,j,4)]*innov[j];return {model,H,Ht,R,PHt,S,Sinv,innov,nis,sigmaRangeM:Math.sqrt(Math.max(1e-9,S[0])),sigmaAzRad:Math.sqrt(Math.max(1e-12,S[5])),sigmaElRad:Math.sqrt(Math.max(1e-12,S[10])),sigmaDopplerMps:Math.sqrt(Math.max(1e-9,S[15]))};}
